variants.when: Many later Oldsmobiles, such as the 2002 Intrigue and Bravada and the 2004 Alero: accelerator pedal method
steps: Reset only after the engine oil and filter have actually been changed.
Turn the key to ON or RUN with the engine off.
Slowly push the accelerator pedal all the way down and let it up three times within five seconds.
The change oil light flashes, or chimes sound and the light goes out, to show the reset worked.
Turn the key off and start the engine. If the change oil light comes back, repeat the steps.

variants.when: Oldsmobiles with a Driver Information Center trip/reset button, such as the 2002 Silhouette
steps: Reset only after the engine oil and filter have actually been changed.
Turn the key to RUN with the engine off.
Press the trip/reset button until OIL shows in the display.
Press and hold the trip/reset button for about five seconds until it reads 100.
Turn the key off. If the change engine oil message comes back, repeat the steps.

variants.when: 2002 Alero: RESET button in the instrument panel fuse block
steps: Reset only after the engine oil and filter have actually been changed.
Press the RESET button in the instrument panel fuse block on the driver's side.
When the CHANGE OIL light starts to flash, press and hold the RESET button again until the chimes sound and the light goes out.

notes: Oldsmobile used the GM Oil Life System on many models, and the reset method differs by model and year, so check the owner's manual for your car.
